proposal.perimeter: The kept rows cover electricity (product = ELK) connections located within the municipality of Amsterdam, broken down by wijk/buurt (neighbourhood) and by customer segment (GVB = grootverbruik, KVB = kleinverbruik). Each row is a quarterly snapshot (peildatum/jaarKwartaal) that reports, for that area/segment, an estimate of the connection's annual electricity supply (standaardjaarLevering) based on historical data, not the consumption that occurred during that particular quarter. A separate column, standaardjaarTeruglevering, records estimated annual feed-back (e.g. from solar panels) and is excluded here since it is a distinct quantity (export/production) rather than consumption. Only Liander's network area appears in this file even though the dataset description mentions a table merged with Stedin data.
proposal.openQuestion: Because standaardjaarLevering is described as an annualized estimate re-derived at each quarterly peildatum rather than a measure of that quarter's actual usage, the four 2024 quarters likely restate close to the same annual figure rather than four additive slices; I am not deciding which single peildatum (e.g. the last quarter of 2024) should be treated as the year's representative annual estimate, nor whether the feed-back volume (standaardjaarTeruglevering) should be netted against delivered supply to obtain a net-consumption figure.
